tweet.text:
The memes are everywhere, so let’s go back over the bet: Cybercab publicly available for under $30k by the end of 2026

My hair is safe for several reasons
1: No deliveries yet. But they’re estimating starting in December so that’s neat
2: Invite only, not actually publicly available yet
3: You can’t actually use it as a cab(??!) It’s limited to private use only. Inside the existing geofenced locations. It’s a paperweight if I take this thing home. That’s one’s not actually part of the bet but yeah not exactly what was promised in this first wave

Hey @grok, set a timer for 48 days from now
